name: Hermes
summary: Shared metrics are off until you enable them. When enabled, local counters are uploaded as packages to the Nous Research telemetry service at https://telemetry.nousresearch.com/v1/telemetry; prompts, responses, and tool arguments are excluded.

optOut.instructions: Set telemetry.shared_metrics.enabled and telemetry.shared_metrics.send to false in the config.yaml of your active profile (~/.hermes/config.yaml for the default profile), or decline the offer if setup asks again.
